What we screen for

The company profile as it was when this run was scored.

Services offered

  • office and commercial cleaning
    includes cleaning of offices, schools, public and commercial buildings; washrooms and communal areas; window and high-level cleaning; communal areas of residential blocks
    excludes clinical areas of hospitals (clinical or hospital cleaning); decontamination of medical or care equipment (specialist equipment decontamination)
  • manned guarding and security
    includes manned guarding and mobile patrols; key holding, alarm response and monitoring; reception, concierge and CCTV monitoring by security staff
    excludes cyber security (IT services)
  • planned and reactive building maintenance
    includes planned and reactive repairs to building fabric; minor works, joinery and carpentry, redecoration and painting; flooring, glazing, windows and doors, roofing repairs; drainage, fencing, handrails, scaffolding and other trade lots of a repairs or maintenance contract; general electrical maintenance and testing
    excludes HVAC, gas, heating, lifts and fire systems (specialist mechanical and electrical (M&E) maintenance); new build, extensions, demolition and capital projects (construction and capital works)
  • grounds maintenance
    includes grass cutting, shrub and hedge maintenance, weed control; maintenance of grounds, parks and green spaces
  • integrated facilities management
    includes one contract combining several FM services, such as cleaning, security and maintenance

Services excluded

  • clinical or hospital cleaning
    includes cleaning of hospital wards, theatres and other clinical areas
  • specialist equipment decontamination
    includes cleaning and decontamination of medical, community care or laboratory equipment
  • specialist mechanical and electrical (M&E) maintenance
    includes HVAC, air conditioning and ventilation systems; gas, boilers and heating systems; lifts and escalators; fire alarms, sprinklers and fire suppression systems
    excludes general electrical maintenance and testing (planned and reactive building maintenance)
  • construction and capital works
    includes new build, extensions, demolition, major refurbishment and other capital projects
    excludes minor works within a repairs or maintenance contract (planned and reactive building maintenance)
  • catering
  • IT services
    includes cyber security, software and IT support
